artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan widening run_post_deploy_reconcile_pass() to a lock-gated system-wide deploy-pending sweep, with a new fixture suite proving fail-before/pass-after and that the completion-deploy gate still refuses against a stale tree.

memory_candidates.content: When widening an /orchestrate self-heal mechanism from invocation-scoped to system-wide, the reporting surface must be scoped separately from the action: a promotion of a task that is NOT a member of the current invocation's .task_numbers must stay out of the multi-task state's .completed_tasks array, because skill-orchestrate's Move 4 derives both its 'Succeeded' table and its .dispatch/ cleanup set from that array -- a foreign task landing there makes the batch report work it never dispatched and clean up another session's dispatch files. Record such out-of-batch self-heals in the notices array with an explicit scope tag instead, and gate the out-of-batch attempt on `task-lock.sh check` (proceed on free/held-stale, skip fail-closed on held-fresh/unresolvable), the same exit-code gate reconcile-task-status.sh already uses.
